edTapHelp: What a click on an instrument does: opens its details pop-up or its TradingView page, or leads to another view. Without a TradingView symbol it is the pop-up.
edTapPathHelp: Where a click leads: a dashboard or a view, e.g. /lovelace/home.
edBlockAutoHelp: How the card moves on by itself.
edElTileBgHelp: A colour and an image of your own behind each tile of the carousel.
edTileBgEnableHelp: Draws the colour and the image below.
edTileBgColorHelp: Background colour for each tile. Empty keeps the usual grey.
edTileBgSizeHelp: How the image meets the edges of a tile.
edBlockPopupHelp: What the pop-up shows that opens on a click.
edElCardBgHelp: A colour and an image of your own behind the whole card.
edCardInsetHelp: How far the card's content stays from its edge, in pixels. Empty follows the theme: where it draws a rim inside the card, the content ends before it.
edCardBgEnableHelp: Draws the colour and the image below.
edCardBgImageHelp: Upload an image, or paste a URL or a local path. Keep it small.
edCardBgSizeHelp: How the image meets the edges of the card.
edCardBgOpacityHelp: How much of the colour and the image comes through, in percent.
edElTitleHelp: How the card's own title is drawn.
edColorHelp: Text colour. Empty keeps the theme's.
edFontHelp: Font size, and whether it is bold, italic, in capitals or underlined.
edLetterSpacingHelp: Space between the letters. Empty leaves the font's own spacing.
edTkChartHeightHelp: Height of the chart in the details, in pixels.
edElRowChangeHelp: The percentage. Its colour is the gain or loss colour.
edTkElPriceHelp: The large price at the top of the details.
emptyHint: No instruments yet. Add one under Settings → Devices & services → Market Ticker Ultra → Add instrument.
noneChosen: None of the instruments chosen for this card exists any more. Choose again in the card's settings.
hEarnings: The day the next quarterly figures are due, from Yahoo Finance. Marked where Yahoo only estimates it.
hOpen: The first price of today's trading.
hHighLow: The highest and the lowest price traded today.
hPrev: The closing price of the last trading day.
h52: The lowest and the highest price of the last 52 weeks.
hVolume: Units traded today so far. Behind it, the daily average of the last three months.
hSma: Simple moving average: the mean of the last 20 closing prices of the period shown.
hSma50: Simple moving average: the mean of the last 50 closing prices of the period shown.
hEma: Exponential moving average over 9 bars: a mean in which the newest prices count most.
hRsi: Relative Strength Index over 14 bars, from 0 to 100. Above 70 the price has risen fast, below 30 it has fallen fast.
hAlertBelow: The lower limit of the price alert. Marked while the price is at or below it.
hAlertAbove: The upper limit of the price alert. Marked while the price is at or above it.
edChartTradesHelp: Marks each purchase and sale in the chart at its day and price, and draws a line at the average price.
edDetailTradesHelp: Each purchase and sale with its day, quantity, price and amount. A sale shows what it realised.
edGroupHelp: The group whose instruments the card shows - a portfolio or a watchlist of the integration.
edGroupsHelp: Which groups' instruments the card shows. While all are ticked, new groups appear by themselves.
hCap: Market capitalisation: the price times the number of all shares.
hPe: Price/earnings ratio: the price divided by the earnings per share of the last twelve months.
hEps: Earnings per share of the last twelve months.
edTitleHelp: A line of its own at the top of the card. Empty shows none.
edFormatHelp: How the card shows the instruments: a running ticker, a compact row, a carousel of tiles, one instrument's details, a portfolio, or the price alerts.
edBlockTableHelp: What the table shows, column by column.
edTablePresetHelp: The columns the table starts with. Automatic takes Portfolio for a portfolio and Compact for a watchlist. Choosing one puts its columns back.
edTableColumnsHelp: Each column's value, a second value under it if you like, and its heading. The arrows move a column, the cross removes it.
edTableHeadingHelp: The name over the column. Empty takes the value's name.
edTableSubNoneHelp: A second, smaller value under the value.
tbInfo_name: The instrument's name with its logo.
tbInfo_symbol: Its symbol at the source, e.g. AAPL.
tbInfo_exchange: The exchange its price comes from.
tbInfo_previous_close: The closing price of the day before.
tbInfo_change: The change since the previous close, as an amount.
tbInfo_change_percent: The change since the previous close, in percent.
tbInfo_trend: An arrow: whether the price rose, fell or stayed with the last update.
tbInfo_year_low: The lowest price of the last 52 weeks.
tbInfo_year_high: The highest price of the last 52 weeks.
tbInfo_spark: A small curve of the price over the day.
tbInfo_spark_week: A small curve of the price over the last five trading days.
tbInfo_spark_month: A small curve of the price over the last month.
tbInfo_news: A symbol where there are new headlines. A click shows them.
tbInfo_week: The change over the last five trading days, in percent.
tbInfo_week_change: The change over the last five trading days, as an amount.
tbInfo_day_gain_percent: What the holding gained or lost today, in percent.
tbInfo_time: The time of the latest price.
tbInfo_alert: The price alerts' bell. A click sets them.
tbInfo_average: The average price paid per unit.
tbInfo_holding: Quantity and average price in one.
tbInfo_value: What the holding is worth now.
tbInfo_share: The holding's share of everything the table shows, in percent.
tbInfo_day_gain: What the holding gained or lost today, as an amount.
tbInfo_gain: Gain or loss since the purchase, as an amount.
tbInfo_gain_percent: Gain or loss since the purchase, in percent.
edTablePillHelp: Draws the value in a pill of the gain or loss colour.
edTableHeaderHelp: The line with the columns' names. A click on a name sorts by that column.
edTableTotalHelp: A last line with the sums of the portfolio: its value, today's change and the gain, where the table has a column for them.
edElTableHeadHelp: The names over the table's columns.
edElTableSubHelp: The second value under a column's value.
edEntriesHelp: What an entry is: an instrument, or a whole portfolio with its value and today's change. A click on a portfolio opens the details of its positions.
tbRowsHelp: What a row is: an instrument, or a whole portfolio with its sums. A click on a portfolio shows its instruments.
edTableGroupColumnsHelp: The columns of the portfolios' overview. The list under Columns is for the instruments of a portfolio.
tbInfoG_positions: How many positions the portfolio holds.
tbInfoG_value: What the portfolio is worth now.
tbInfoG_share: The portfolio's share of all portfolios shown, in percent.
tbInfoG_day_gain: What the portfolio gained or lost today, as an amount.
tbInfoG_day_gain_percent: What the portfolio gained or lost today, in percent.
tbInfoG_gain: The portfolio's gain or loss since the purchases, as an amount.
tbInfoG_gain_percent: The portfolio's gain or loss since the purchases, in percent.
tbInfoG_spark: A small curve of the portfolio's performance over the day.
tbInfoG_spark_week: A small curve of the portfolio's performance over the last five trading days.
tbInfoG_spark_month: A small curve of the portfolio's performance over the last month.
edTableSearchHelp: A field beside the name's heading that filters the rows by name or symbol.
edTableRefreshHelp: A button at the top right that fetches the prices again and says when they were last fetched.
edElTableRefreshHelp: The button at the top right, with the time since the last fetch.
edRefreshBgHelp: Draws the button on a pill.
edRefreshBgColorHelp: Colour of the pill. Empty keeps the theme's.
edElTableDividerHelp: The lines between the table's rows.
edShowTableLinesHelp: Draws the lines between the rows.
edElTableTotalHelp: The last line with the sums.
edElTablePillHelp: The pill around a value. Its colour is the gain or loss colour.
edPillRadiusHelp: How round the pill's corners are, e.g. 6px. Empty is fully round.
edPillFillHelp: How strongly the gain or loss colour fills the pill, in percent.
edElTableArrowHelp: The trend's arrows. Their colour is the gain or loss colour.
edTrendIconHelp: The symbol the Trend column shows for this.
perfChoose: There is no portfolio yet whose performance could be shown.
perfEmpty: Not enough prices yet for this period.
edBlockAllocHelp: The parts of the portfolio on the card.
edShowAllocLogoHelp: Each position's logo before its name.
edAllocViewHelp: How the positions' shares are drawn.
edAllocListHelp: What the list shows first: each position's share and value, or its gain.
edShowAllocSwitchHelp: A button on the card that switches the list between allocation and gain.
edElAllocSwitchHelp: The button that switches the list between allocation and gain.
edElAllocToGainHelp: The button while the allocation is shown.
edElAllocToSharesHelp: The button while the gains are shown.
edElAllocGainPctHelp: A position's gain in percent. It keeps the gain or loss colour.
edElAllocGainAmountHelp: A position's gain as an amount. It keeps the gain or loss colour.
edShowAllocRingHelp: The ring with each position's share, in the colour set for its instrument.
edShowAllocTotalHelp: The sum of all positions, in the base currency.
edShowAllocValueHelp: Each position's value in the base currency.
edShowPerfIndexHelp: The index set for the portfolio, as a second line.
edElAllocNameHelp: The name of a position in the list.
edElAllocShareHelp: The share of a position in the list.
edElAllocValueHelp: The value of a position in the list.
edElPerfLegendHelp: The line with the names of the portfolio and the index above the chart. The returns keep the gain or loss colour.
edElPerfRangesHelp: The periods beside the performance's heading.
edElPerfAxisHelp: The percentages at the right of the performance's chart.
edBlockPerfHelp: The portfolio's return over a period, beside its index.
edPerfHeadingHelp: The words above the performance. Empty keeps the card's own.
edPerfRangeHelp: The period the performance shows first. Beside it, which periods it offers.
edLinePerfHelp: The line of the portfolio's return: colours and width.
edLinePerfGridHelp: The horizontal lines of the performance's chart: colour, style and width.
edShowPerfGridHelp: Draws the horizontal lines of the performance's chart.
edLinePerfIndexHelp: The line of the index: colour, style and width.
edShowPerfHelp: The portfolio's time-weighted return over a period, beside the index set for its group.
allocEmpty: Nothing held among this card's instruments.
edDetailInstrumentHelp: The instrument the card opens on. Arrows on the card step through the others.
edBlockDetailHelp: What the card shows of its instrument.
edDetailOff: This format has no entries and nothing that moves, so there is nothing to set up here.
edBlockLiveHelp: Buttons for adding, changing and removing instruments on the card. Administrators only.
edElLiveHelp: Symbol, colour and size of the buttons for adding, changing and removing an instrument.
edLiveAddHelp: Symbol, colour and size of the +.
edLiveEditHelp: Symbol, colour and size of the pencil.
edLiveRemoveHelp: Symbol, colour and size of the trash can.
edToolIconHelp: The button's symbol. Emptied, the default comes back.
edAddColorHelp: Colour of the +. Empty keeps the theme's green.
edEditColorHelp: Colour of the pencil. Empty keeps the theme's accent colour.
edRemoveColorHelp: Colour of the trash can. Empty keeps the theme's red.
edShowAddHelp: A + that adds an instrument. It appears while the mouse is over an instrument and stands at the top right of the details.
edShowEditHelp: A pencil that changes an instrument. It appears while the mouse is over an instrument and stands at the top right of the details.
edShowRemoveHelp: A trash can that removes an instrument after asking once. It appears while the mouse is over an instrument and stands at the top right of the details.
hAlertNone: A line with the alert symbol while no price alert is set. The symbol opens the alerts; administrators only.
edElAlertsNameHelp: The name of an instrument in the list of price alerts.
edElAlertsLimitHelp: The two limits beside the track. A limit that is reached keeps the alert's colour.
edElAlertsTrackHelp: The track between the limits, and the mark of the price on it.
edAlertsTrackColorHelp: Colour of the track. Empty keeps the card's own.
edAlertsMarkColorHelp: Colour of the price's mark. Empty keeps the text colour.
edAlertsTrackHeightHelp: Height of the track, 2 to 20 pixels.
edAlertsMarkWidthHelp: Width of the price's mark, 1 to 12 pixels.
edElAlertHelp: The symbol of the price alerts, wherever it stands on the card.
edAlertNoneIconHelp: The symbol while no alert is set.
edAlertNoneColorHelp: Colour of the symbol while no alert is set. Empty keeps the theme's.
edAlertSizeHelp: Size of the symbol, e.g. 18px. Empty keeps the card's own.
edAlertIconHelp: The symbol while an alert is set.
edAlertColorHelp: Colour of the symbol while an alert is set. Empty keeps the theme's.
edAlertOnIconHelp: The symbol while the price is at or beyond a limit.
edAlertOnColorHelp: Colour of the symbol and the limit while an alert is on. Empty keeps the theme's warning colour.
edRowAlertHelp: A symbol behind the name while a price alert is set, in another colour while it is on.
removeExplain: The instrument is removed from the integration. This cannot be undone.
edPickHelp: Which instruments the card shows, and in which order. While all are ticked and none is moved, new ones appear by themselves.
edSortHelp: The order of the instruments: as listed, by name, or by today's change.
edHideAmountsHelp: Hides quantity, value and gain in money. Prices and percentages stay.
edBlockEntryHelp: The parts of an instrument in the ticker, the row or the tile.
edRowLogoHelp: The instrument's logo, or a disc with its first letter.
edRowSymbolHelp: The symbol the instrument trades under, such as AAPL for Apple.
edRowPriceHelp: The current price. An index has no currency.
edRowChangeHelp: Today's change in percent, in the gain or the loss colour.
edRowSparklineHelp: The small curve of the day, in the compact row and the carousel.
edDetailTvHelp: TradingView's logo at the top right of the details, a link to the instrument's page there. An instrument without a TradingView symbol has none.
edDetailLogoHelp: The instrument's logo in front of its name.
edDetailPositionHelp: A box under the chart with quantity, value, gain or loss, average price, the change, and what was realised and paid in fees and taxes.
edDetailChartHelp: The price chart with its periods.
edDetailVolumeHelp: The traded volume as bars under the chart.
edDetailSmaHelp: The simple moving average over 20 bars as a line in the chart, with its last value among the figures.
edDetailSma50Help: The simple moving average over 50 bars as a line in the chart, with its last value among the figures.
edDetailEmaHelp: The exponential moving average over 9 bars as a line in the chart, with its last value among the figures.
edDetailRsiHelp: The Relative Strength Index over 14 bars as a strip under the chart, with its last value among the figures.
edDetailFactsHelp: The list of figures. Below, each has its own switch and arrows for its place; a row appears only where there is a value.
edRangeHelp: The period the chart shows first. Beside it, which periods the chart offers.
edChartStyleHelp: Candlesticks or a line. Automatic draws candlesticks up to one year and a line beyond.
edAutoAdvanceHelp: Moves on to the next instrument by itself. It pauses while the pointer is over the card.
edEffectHelp: How the change from one instrument to the next looks, and how long it takes.
edEffectTypeHelp: How one instrument gives way to the next.
edEffectDurationHelp: How long the change takes, from 100 to 3000 milliseconds.
edEndlessLoopHelp: After the last instrument the first follows directly.
edAutoIntervalHelp: Seconds an instrument stands before the next, 2 to 120. In the ticker, how long one takes to pass.
edElGainHelp: The colours of gains, losses and new headlines, everywhere on the card.
edGainColorHelp: Colour for a rise. Empty keeps the card's green.
edLossColorHelp: Colour for a fall. Empty keeps the card's red.
edElLogoHelp: The round logo of an entry.
edElRowSymbolHelp: The instrument's symbol in an entry.
edElRowNameHelp: The instrument's name in an entry.
edElDetailSubHelp: The line under the name: symbol, exchange and market state.
edElSubSymbolHelp: The symbol in the info line.
edElSubExchangeHelp: The exchange in the info line.
edElSubStateHelp: Open, closed, pre-market or after hours.
edDetailNewsHelp: The newest headlines about the instrument. A click opens the article in a new tab.
edNewsCountHelp: How many headlines are shown at most, 1 to 20.
edRowNewsHelp: A symbol behind the name while there are headlines you have not seen yet.
edNewsNewColorHelp: Colour of the number of new headlines, their mark and the symbol. Empty keeps the theme's primary colour.
edNewsDaysHelp: Hides headlines older than this many days. 0 shows all.
edNewsCompactHelp: Shows only the number of headlines, with the new ones in brackets. A click opens the list.
edBlockAllocNewsHelp: The newest headlines about the portfolio's positions.
edShowAllocNewsHelp: The newest headlines about the positions. A click opens the article in a new tab.
edElStyleLineHelp: The button while candlesticks are shown.
edElStyleCandlesHelp: The button while a line is shown.
edElRangeOffHelp: The periods that are not on show.
edElRangeOnHelp: The period that is on show.
edLineGridHelp: The horizontal lines of the chart: colour, style and width.
edShowGridHelp: Draws the horizontal lines of the chart.
edShowRefHelp: Draws the line at the previous close.
edElTvLogoHelp: The logo at the top right of the details.
edTvColorHelp: Colour of the logo. Empty is black on a light theme and white on a dark one.
edPosBoxColorHelp: Background colour of the box. Empty keeps the theme's.
edElPosGainHelp: The gain or loss at the right. Its colour is the gain or loss colour.
edElPosSubHelp: Average price, the change, realised gain, fees and taxes.
edShowLinesHelp: Draws the lines between the figures.
edGridColorHelp: Colour of the grid lines. Empty keeps the theme's.
edLineRefHelp: The line at the previous close: colour, style and width.
edRefColorHelp: Colour of the line. Empty keeps the theme's.
edElDetailChangeHelp: The change under the price. Its colour is the gain or loss colour.
edElDetailStyleHelp: The button that switches between candlesticks and a line.
edElDetailYAxisHelp: The figures at the right of the chart.
edElPopNameHelp: The instrument's name at the top of the details.
edChartLineHelp: Width of the price line, in pixels. Candlesticks have no line.
edLinePriceHelp: Colours and width of the price line, where the chart is drawn as a line.
edLineUpHelp: Colour of the line above the period's starting value. Empty keeps the gain colour.
edLineDownHelp: Colour of the line below the period's starting value. Empty keeps the loss colour.
edVolBlockHelp: Colours and strength of the volume bars.
edVolUpHelp: Colour of the bars of rising candles. Empty keeps the gain colour.
edVolDownHelp: Colour of the bars of falling candles. Empty keeps the loss colour.
edVolOpacityHelp: Strength of the bars, from 5 to 100 percent.
edLineSmaHelp: Colour and width of the SMA 20 line.
edLineSma50Help: Colour and width of the SMA 50 line.
edLineEmaHelp: Colour and width of the EMA 9 line.
edLineRsiHelp: Colour and width of the RSI line.
edLineWidthHelp: Width of the line in pixels, e.g. 1.5.
edSmaColorHelp: Colour of the SMA 20 line. Empty keeps the card's blue.
edSma50ColorHelp: Colour of the SMA 50 line. Empty keeps the card's purple.
edEmaColorHelp: Colour of the EMA 9 line. Empty keeps the card's yellow.
edRsiColorHelp: Colour of the RSI's line. Empty keeps the card's cyan.
